startercn - Build your own shadcn registry

name: startercn
summary: Template for building and publishing a shadcn/ui component registry, with a docs site, landing page and agent-ready endpoints.
description: A fork-and-deploy template for creating and publishing custom shadcn registry components: one component file plus a registry.json entry, a Fumadocs documentation site and a landing page, and a registry build script. It is AI-agent ready (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, an agent skill route and API catalog endpoints), and bakes in web audio feedback, haptics, motion animations and Next.js view transitions.
contains: template for publishing a custom shadcn registry
landing page and Fumadocs documentation site
one component file plus registry.json to edit
llms.txt, llms-full.txt, agent skill route and API catalog endpoints
web audio feedback and web haptics
motion animations, animated icons and Next.js view transitions
